answer: Anchor each identity to a zero-knowledge proof of uniqueness from a real-world credential: one passport proves one agent, without ever revealing the document. A sybil operator spirals into forgery economics — ten thousand fake agents demand ten thousand fraudulent documents, and the delta between cloning software and cloning people becomes enormous. Every proof lands on a public ridge where a credential used twice is instantly visible and burns both identities. Limits: forged-document markets exist, and the undocumented are excluded — so this is a high-cost gate, not a universal one.
